rules.description: Checks that no WaterQualitySite or StatVar entities are deleted on refresh.
Verify exact StatVar completeness per input table (27 for Ground Water and Surface Water; 21 for Retained Ground Water) with non-zero observations.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_svs, MIN(NumObservations) AS min_obs, MAX(CASE WHEN StatVar = 'Concentration_Fluorine_BodyOfWater_GroundWater' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_retained FROM stats
params.condition: ((is_retained = 1 AND total_svs >= 21) OR (is_retained = 0 AND total_svs >= 27)) AND min_obs > 0

rules.description: Verify active Ground Water StatVars meet their scoped freshness boundaries (2023-04 for primary ions, 2022-04 for trace metals/field properties, 2020-10 for historical trace elements; 2018 for the retained historical input table).

params.query: SELECT s.StatVar, s.MaxDate, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stats WHERE StatVar = 'Concentration_Fluorine_BodyOfWater_GroundWater') AS is_retained FROM stats s WHERE regexp_matches(s.StatVar, '_GroundWater$')
params.condition: CASE WHEN is_retained THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2018' WHEN StatVar IN ('Concentration_Carbonate_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Calcium_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Chloride_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Potassium_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Magnesium_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Sodium_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Sulfate_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'ResidualSodiumCarbonate_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'SodiumAdsorptionRatio_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'WaterHardness_BodyOfWater_GroundWater') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2023-04' WHEN StatVar IN ('Concentration_Iron_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Nitrate_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Manganese_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Zinc_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Copper_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'Concentration_Uranium_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'ElectricalConductivity_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'WaterAlkalinity_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'TotalDissolvedSolids_BodyOfWater_GroundWater', 'DissolvedOxygen_BodyOfWater_GroundWater') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2022-04' ELSE CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2020-10' END

rules.description: Verify Surface Water StatVars meet their scoped freshness boundaries (2020-01 for active parameters, 2019-02 for Nitrate/pH, and 2018-04 for Cyanide/Silver).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate FROM stats WHERE regexp_matches(StatVar, '_SurfaceWater$')
params.condition: CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Concentration_Cyanide_BodyOfWater_SurfaceWater', 'Concentration_Silver_BodyOfWater_SurfaceWater') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2018-04' WHEN StatVar IN ('Concentration_Nitrate_BodyOfWater_SurfaceWater', 'PotentialOfHydrogen_BodyOfWater_SurfaceWater') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2019-02' ELSE CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) >= '2020-01' END
